clm10398-n106.summary: The writer, delayed at The Hague by an errand for the Nuncio in Amsterdam, reports that he pressed a person in code (g 34) hard and brought him to admit that nothing better exists for the greatness of his house, while the wife laughs at it. He asks his correspondent in London to maintain that he did not come there for a purpose that is in code, but for something else, and sends greetings to Father Anderson, the Count and a gentleman with a Capuchin beard. The persons and subjects in code are not read.
clm10398-n106.en:
Sir,
